The floated orange box sits at the left edge of its containing block and this paragraph wraps around it, shortening its line boxes to avoid the float band. Text continues to flow beside the float and then below it once the float's height is exhausted, exactly as CSS 2.1 section 9.5 describes for left-floated elements.

A second paragraph also wraps beside the float and demonstrates that line boxes from multiple subsequent blocks all avoid the float region rather than overlapping it.
